description: Which holders of a vault are AI-agent identities: owners of ERC-8004 registrations and Virtuals ACP wallets. Returns how many, their share of the vault and dollars, and per address what it does elsewhere (agents registered, x402 payments made and received, ACP jobs). A floor: only vaults whose holders we read and identities we read; an address that registered an agent is not proof software made the deposit. FREE.
